from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 11:20 2022 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 October 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team and the Scuderia AlphaTauri team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eleven and a half hour period which commenced at 23:30 on 21 October, fourteen and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ended three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 11:00 on 22 October. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team and the Scuderia AlphaTauri team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
title: Curfew
